objective: Hold Formal V2 P(T) fixed and research only D(H,A|T): home/away goal allocation, goal difference, draw structure and exact-score allocation.

data_gate.component_source: Formal V2 already-computed Frozen V1 and XG component score matrices from state.predict_batch(..., include_matrix=True)

candidate_family.name: COMPONENT_DISAGREEMENT_CONDITIONAL_TILT
candidate_family.candidate_conditional: q_beta(h,a|T) proportional to q(h,a|T) * exp(beta * s_T * (h-a))
candidate_family.total_marginal_constraint: P_beta(T) == P_FormalV2(T) for every represented T
candidate_family.beta_zero_identity: beta=0 returns Formal V2 score matrix exactly
candidate_family.support_rule: No new (H,A) cell and no fabricated tail state; operate only on cells already present in Formal V2 component support.

development_and_confirmation.historical_split: strict chronological rolling-origin by kickoff; never random split
development_and_confirmation.beta_fit: single deterministic scalar minimization of mean conditional-score NLL on eligible development fixtures; no grid search; optimizer bounds and tolerance must be frozen before any fresh confirmation labels
ablation: sign-only component disagreement with the same single beta fit rule
full magnitude component disagreement prereg candidate
development_and_confirmation.fresh_confirmation: prospective fixtures predicted only after final beta and code HEAD are frozen; labels remain sealed until cohort closes
development_and_confirmation.required_n_rule: Before fresh-label opening, compute paired development loss-difference standard deviation sigma_dev using only POST_VIEW_DEVELOPMENT identities; required_n=max(1000,ceil(((1.959964+0.841621)*sigma_dev/0.003)^2)); freeze required_n and cohort rule in an immutable receipt before enrollment.

metrics.primary: paired conditional exact-score negative log loss: -log P(H,A|T)
metrics.equivalence_note: Because P(T) is fixed fixture-by-fixture, candidate-vs-baseline delta in conditional exact-score NLL equals delta in full joint-score NLL.

engineering_preconditions: P(T) invariant max_abs_error <= 5e-12 on every fixture
promotion_line.scientific_primary: On the fresh confirmation cohort, mean(candidate conditional NLL - Formal V2 conditional NLL) <= -0.003 and the two-sided 95% paired confidence interval upper bound is < 0.
secondary_guardrails: no competition with >=100 fresh eligible fixtures may have conditional-NLL degradation > +0.01 unless multiplicity-adjusted evidence supports heterogeneity and a separately preregistered scope rule exists

stop_conditions: component matrices cannot be obtained without changing Formal V2 or production wiring
mechanical P(T) invariance cannot be guaranteed
candidate requires new labels before prereg freeze
candidate requires a second provider, market feed, fuzzy identity, or post-cutoff data
candidate requires more than the single preregistered beta parameter
candidate requires fabricated score support or tail mass
exact base or formal immutable blob identity drifts
